raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / NEW DEVELOPMENTS / NUOVO TRILOCALE - FRONTE MARE A JESOLO LIDO NEW DEVELOPMENT · APARTMENT Nuovo Trilocale - fronte mare a Jesolo Lido PIAZZA TORINO · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €512,000 Photos (36) Floor plans (0) 1 / 36 FLOOR AREA 90 m² BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT Yes ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo Lido! This exclusive newly built three-room apartment is located on the sixth floor of the prestigious W-ONE residence, in the heart of Jesolo Lido. Characterized by maximum efficiency with Energy Class A4, the property (Unit U20) offers perfectly optimized spaces consisting of a bright open-plan living area, two cozy bedrooms, two carefully finished bathrooms, and a beautiful livable terrace. The property also includes a private parking space and a reserved beach spot. - The Spaces of the Three-Room Apartment and the Livable Terrace The living area stands out for its extraordinary brightness and harmoniously blends with the large livable terrace, creating an ideal environment for outdoor dining and moments of pure relaxation. The sleeping area consists of two comfortable bedrooms and two contemporary designed bathrooms, crafted to ensure maximum daily functionality within a refined modern style. - Exclusive Services of the Residence Living in W-ONE means accessing an experience of superior comfort. Outside there is a spacious condominium pool perfect for summer days while inside there is a fully equipped gym accessible 24/7. The private parking space and reserved beach spot guarantee enjoying summer season in total privacy and convenience, with the sea just steps away from home. - Benefits and Purchase Services The investment becomes even more advantageous thanks to the Sisma Bonus Purchases scheme, with the proposed price already calculated net of tax benefits. For those seeking customized solutions, our interior designers are available to define materials and finishes tailored to your style. Additionally, if you need to sell your current property, we handle all exchanges ensuring that enhancing your property makes transitioning into your new home simple and worry-free. Experience the sea right at home!
